shots: BPA people will color-code|their calendar for a Tuesday,
bring a backup tie|to bowling night,
then ask, how'd you know|I went to nationals?
You made a spreadsheet|to track your spreadsheets,
you used parliamentary procedure|to pick family dinner,
and you call lunch|a networking opportunity.
Seems cool being|a normal BPA member.
I wish I could be one,
but I can't because|I went to nationals.
